title: Explicit Form of the Budget Seed
statement: For every Boolean word $x$, the word formed by concatenating a block of true bits of length equal to the number of binary digits of $|x|$ after the first two, then a false bit, then a block of true bits of length equal to the number of binary digits of $|x|$ after the first digit, is the concatenation of a block of true bits of length $\max\{\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor-1,0\}$, a false bit, and a block of true bits of length $\lfloor\log_2 |x|\rfloor$.
